digest.component_or_area: reconciler coordinator outcome versioning and state contract
propositions: Versioned lifecycle, retry, fuse, and outcome sections must be additive and ignorable by older readers while preserving existing mutation fields and canonical hash.

Cursor, baseline, binding, and last-pass state advance only after proven postconditions; deferred, failed, skipped, and commit_unknown work remains eligible for re-observation and not counted as applied.

The binding_store repair call must execute after staleness validation (ensure_selection_current) and before the first remote fetch to prevent race between durable retirement intent and fresh observation.

Applied and recovered mutation tallies must be disjoint and exact; reconcile unfolds the legacy folded applied count to produce five mutually exclusive outcome buckets summing to total mutation count.
All preview, log, and manifest output must redact secrets and bound every diagnostic field and collection without unbounded content.
reconcile.py must remain under 800-line cap via extraction along existing call-graph seams with no limit raise.
